pages.title: Stone on the Move
pages.text: A working quarry turns magnetic technology into production.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Place four Magnetic Lights in a rectangle behind the quarry, wait for connecting lightning and put Smasher inside. Drops emerge above the main block; an exhausted quarry becomes dormant.
